title: Neo Styler Landing Composition
description: A landing page's proposed structure and draft copy: the first view, the sections in display order (the last one is a closing CV section, then the form), and the form. propose returns one from a brief; a person or an agent may edit it before materialize turns it into a Site AST and content. Only facts from the brief are allowed; a section with no material is left out rather than invented.

cta_label.description: Defaults to the brief's CV label.

sub_cta_section.description: The secondary button scrolls to this section.

sections.description: Keys are unique. cta / cta-2 … are mid-page CV sections and closing is the last one; their link is target form. Any other key is free.

notes.description: Why the page is composed this way, for the person reviewing it; also lists any link the service dropped because its destination was not in the brief.
